title: Deadly France wildfire grows past the size of Paris • FRANCE 24 English
text:
France 24 journalist Carys Garland reports from southern France, where a deadly wildfire expanded to cover an area larger than Paris, with firefighters struggling to keep the blaze from spreading. French officials said the "unprecedented" scale of the fire is undeniably linked to climate change and called for reform to the nation’s land management policies.
